title: Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery, School Holiday Workshops
summary: Free and low-cost school holiday art workshops at MPRG: hands-on, artist-led, tied to current exhibitions. Kids 8+, teens and families. Bookings essential.
priceRange: Family activity spaces free; gallery entry ticketed with a concession rate; workshops vary
accessibilityNotes: Fully accessible gallery; wheelchair friendly; air conditioned
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street market (Wednesday); local cafes
suggestedItineraryPairing: Gallery workshop, beach walk, Main Street lunch
editorVerdict: The school-holiday move when the kids need something built-in, indoors, and actually good rather than just available.
editorNote:
MPRG runs hands-on, artist-led workshops every school holiday break, tied to whatever is on the gallery walls at the time. Kids 8+ get the workshops proper; the family activity space runs year-round and is free.

Bookings are essential, places go quickly and the gallery posts dates roughly four weeks ahead on Facebook. Workshop pricing varies but stays sensible. Gallery entry is ticketed, with a concession rate.

Plan a full Mornington morning: workshop 10am to 1pm, lunch on Main Street, foreshore walk if the weather is on. The Wednesday Main Street market overlaps if you can time it.
